workExperiences.company: EventPop (acquired by OPN TH in 2021, divested in 2023)
details: Designed and built core services — ticketing, seating, payments, fee calculation, billing, reporting, public APIs — in Ruby on Rails; sold 2M+ tickets in 6 years
Integrated payment providers (Omise, ThaiEPay, 123 by 2C2P, SCB-Easy, K-PayPlus, K-PaymentGateway) processing 1B+ THB, plus 3rd-party services (Kerry Express, DHL, Queue-It, Refund Protect, Skootar)
Pioneered DevOps practices — Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Drone CI, ArgoCD, FluxCD, Terraform) — keeping daily releases possible
Interviewed 50+ software engineers and designed technical interview questions & on-site coding challenges
Co-founded one of the first makerspaces in Bangkok, pioneering the Maker Movement in Thailand
Hosted 3D-modeling, 3D-printing, Arduino & IoT workshops with 100+ participants, and made 10+ Intel Galileo tutorial video chapters for Intel Thailand
Built hardware products for clients & startups — including the smart door-lock system for Hubba, Bangkok's first co-working space — and served 50+ 3D-printing clients
Built an internet-connected smart-locker system with Node.js & React on embedded Linux, Arduino, and Raspberry Pi, including Nayax cashless-payment integration for vending machines
Built 20+ Facebook web apps (CodeIgniter, Facebook API), web platforms on Ruby on Rails 3 & 4, and hybrid iOS apps (PhoneGap, RubyMotion)
Built part of wongnai.com with Java & Spring MVC; first exposure to TDD and early-stage startup culture
